checks.description: Checks whether a supported host firewall manager (ufw, firewalld, or the nftables service) reports itself active.
checks.expected_value: A host firewall (ufw, firewalld, or nftables) is active
checks.mapping_note: No CIS or other framework mapping is claimed for the experimental Linux checks until each mapping is validated.
checks.name: Linux Firewall Active
checks.remediation: Enable and start a host firewall (for example: sudo ufw enable, or enable the firewalld/nftables service).

checks.description: Checks whether any block device is LUKS-encrypted, as reported by lsblk.
checks.expected_value: At least one block device is LUKS-encrypted
checks.mapping_note: No CIS or other framework mapping is claimed for the experimental Linux checks until each mapping is validated.
checks.name: Disk Encryption (LUKS) Present
checks.remediation: Encrypt volumes with LUKS (normally chosen at install time) and back up the recovery keys using an approved process.

checks.description: Checks that no guest account with an interactive shell exists in /etc/passwd.
checks.expected_value: No enabled guest account with an interactive shell exists
checks.mapping_note: No CIS or other framework mapping is claimed for the experimental Linux checks until each mapping is validated.
checks.name: Guest Account Disabled
checks.remediation: Remove the guest account or set its shell to /usr/sbin/nologin.

checks.description: Checks the effective PermitRootLogin setting of OpenSSH (explicit value, or the compiled default when unset).
checks.expected_value: sshd does not allow password-based root login (PermitRootLogin no or prohibit-password)
checks.mapping_note: No CIS or other framework mapping is claimed for the experimental Linux checks until each mapping is validated.
checks.name: SSH Root Password Login Disabled
checks.remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin prohibit-password' or 'no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.

checks.description: Checks whether automatic updates are enabled via unattended-upgrades (APT) or dnf-automatic (DNF).
checks.expected_value: Automatic security updates are enabled (unattended-upgrades or dnf-automatic)
checks.mapping_note: No CIS or other framework mapping is claimed for the experimental Linux checks until each mapping is validated.
checks.name: Automatic Security Updates Enabled
checks.remediation: Enable automatic security updates (for example: sudo dpkg-reconfigure unattended-upgrades, or enable dnf-automatic.timer).

description: Experimental Linux technical configuration checks for SecureAudit. Written fresh in October 2026; the archived prototype scanners were empty files and contained nothing to revive. Framework mappings are pending validation and are deliberately not claimed.
